summary: Iteration 3: Tested the new Unit 3 (3D graphics) feature end-to-end. Backend suite extended (not rewritten) with a TestUnit3 class (13 new tests) covering unit listing order, 8 topic ids/schema, the 4 solved numericals & their results, final_sections counts (7 formulas / 6 hooks / 8 LMR / 10 must-memorize), both comparison tables and diagram_key mapping. All 24 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend Playwright verified: 3-tab switcher, Unit 3 load (title, '8 Topics · Compact' badge), cheat card positioned between cover and first topic, all 8 topic cards, SVG diagrams present exactly for axes-3d/projection-tree/parallel-vs-perspective/zbuffer/bezier and absent for 3d-translate-scale/3d-rotation/bspline, sidebar navigation + scroll-spy, and Unit3->Unit1->Unit3 round trip with no stale content and zero console/page errors.

issues: Label overlap: bold caption 'Right-handed: curl fingers x -> y, thumb = +z' (text centered x=210,y=244) runs into the '+z (towards you)' axis label (x=60,y=256) and over the z-axis arrowhead at (75,242) in DiagramsD.jsx Axes3DDiagram. Cosmetic only; suggest moving the caption right/down or shortening it.

action_items: Optional cosmetic fix: resolve text overlap in Axes3DDiagram (DiagramsD.jsx) between the right-hand-rule caption and the '+z (towards you)' label.
critical_code_review_comments: content_unit3.py (304 lines) and the diagrams split into A-D files keep files under the 700-line guideline - good.
Unit 3 schema matches Units 1-2 compact schema exactly (quick_facts, no key_points), so the data-driven App.js needed no change - verified rendering for topics with and without diagram_key.
GET /api/units listing remains lightweight (no topics payload) and _id is excluded on all responses.
seed_data_creation: None - content is seeded idempotently by the backend lifespan; no test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers Units 1, 2 and 3 (24 tests, all passing). Units 1 & 2 UI validated in iterations 1-2; Unit 3 UI validated here (desktop 1920). Mobile menu and print/PDF layout for Unit 3 were NOT retested per request scope - retest if print CSS changes.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only finding is a static SVG label coordinate collision in Axes3DDiagram (hardcoded x/y positions in DiagramsD.jsx lines 20 and 26).
